id: AT-RN-06 (HOME-GUARD: no case reaches the real home)
note: HOME-GUARD (0.1.2): a kit test elsewhere ran a planted hook with the real HOME and wiped ~/.claude/settings.json; the settings writer (lib/settings_write.pm) writes ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/settings.json. Inside a case the runner's own HOME is the case's $HOME and no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set; home_guard refuses, before the fork, a helper call or command whose HOME is the real home, the account's home or a link to it, missing, empty or outside the temp folders, or whose CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is the real ~/.claude (also when TMPDIR is the home) or not under a temp folder, and a declared builtin home at the account's home. A child run of the runner over two case-local cases (a helper call with no HOME; one with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR outside the temp folders) fails both with the guard's line

steps.name: the guard and the runner's own environment
a child run: both helper calls refused, both cases fail

stdout_has: ^#   runner error: HOME-GUARD: helper /bin/sh: no HOME \(the helper would use the account's home\); not started$
^#   runner error: HOME-GUARD: helper /bin/sh: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR /nonexistent-home-guard-cfg is not under a temp folder; not started$
